free_tier.stated: no published free tier: sandboxes pause and resume with full state preserved, a Volume is independent persistent storage that mounts into several sandboxes in beta, and the API has an E2B compatibility mode

egress.terms: not published: the fee page (https://astraflow.ucloud.cn/docs/agent-sandbox/product/fee.md) lists vCPU, memory, local storage and persistent storage and no outbound transfer allowance or price; every sandbox has outbound internet access by default

interface_detail: Python SDK (`pip install ucloud-sandbox`, authenticated with `UCLOUD_SANDBOX_API_KEY`), the UCloud Sandbox CLI and an E2B-compatible mode; no SSH or REST reference read

limits.value: a sandbox can be paused and resumed with its full running state preserved
a Volume is independent of a sandbox and can mount into several, in beta
the billing and quota details are on pages this record does not cite

confidence_note: the documentation index was read on 2026-10-22 (Chinese) and states the pause-and-resume state model, the beta Volume and the E2B compatibility. The billing and quota pages it links were not read, so no figure is asserted
